tools.name: millionverifier_credits
tools.description: Read remaining MillionVerifier credits without starting verification.

tools.name: millionverifier_verify_email
tools.description: Verify one email using MillionVerifier's real-time API. Can spend credits and requires confirm:true. The vendor timeout is 10 seconds; this charged GET is never retried. Unknown/catch-all results do not establish deliverability. If the response is lost, check the dashboard before submitting again.

tools.name: millionverifier_upload_file
tools.description: Create and upload a CSV of 1–1,000 emails for bulk verification. Can start a billable job and spend credits; requires confirm:true. Returns a file ID for millionverifier_file_info. Never retries or automatically polls. A timed-out submission may still create a job; check the dashboard before repeati

tools.name: millionverifier_file_info
tools.description: Read an existing bulk file's verification status, progress and aggregate result counts using its file ID. Includes failed/canceled jobs without starting, stopping or re-verifying anything. Does not download individual email results. Wait between polls.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: millionverifier_verify_email, millionverifier_upload_file, millionverifier_file_info · Private data: millionverifier_upload_file, millionverifier_file_info · Public sink: millionverifier_verify_email, millionverifier_upload_file, millionverifier_file_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: millionverifier_verify_email, millionverifier_upload_file, millionverifier_file_info · Private data: millionverifier_upload_file, millionverifier_file_info · Public sink: millionverifier_verify_email, millionverifier_upload_file, millionverifier_file_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
